entities.name: Isidore of Miletus the Younger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Isidore of Miletus the Younger or simply Isidore the Younger was a Byzantine architect and a nephew of the architect Isidore of Miletus. Like his uncle, he was a native of Miletus.
